query.order: Ascending physical invocation path/start_byte/end_byte/role, then target declaration path/start_byte/end_byte. Page occurrence relations, not deduplicated callee names.

budget_units.examined_relationships: Every adjacency occurrence inspected, including filter rejection; charge before inspection.
budget_units.returned_entities: Distinct returned declaration identities, seed excluded from the result rows.
budget_units.response_bytes: Entire canonical UTF-8 JSON response, including counts/cursor/metadata; excerpts also count.
budget_units.clock: Injectable monotonic work clock for finite tests; real measured clock separately.

assertions.note: Compact source handles/names/ranges, no full declaration bodies/excerpts. If metadata exceeds 32 KiB, bounded pagination is required rather than output overflow.

assertions.counts: Exact total 113 only if a captured adjacency-degree index proves it without extra query inspection; otherwise lower_bound>=7 or unknown. No truncated count presented as exact.

assertions.note: The adapter cannot borrow the grader count of 12. Rejected rows consume work; counting all filtered matches before truncating would fail.

assertions.response_scope: Compact physical handles/path/ranges/name; no declaration body excerpts.
assertions: No skips or duplicate occurrence keys.
Concatenated rows equal the physically ordered source oracle.
Output exhaustion does not advance past the first unreturned row; first continuation index is 17.
Cursor binds snapshot generation, analyzer/rules identity, source scope, operation, seed, filter, order and expiry.
Changed scope/filter/operation/rules or expired cursor is rejected before relationship inspection.
assertions.count_rule: Exact source total only from a proved captured index; otherwise labeled lower_bound/unknown.

assertions: Serialized full response <=1024 bytes or explicit pre-work minimum-envelope refusal.
No entire adjacency traversal/export before byte trimming.
No lost first-unemitted occurrence on continuation.
A cursor/count envelope itself counts against the cap; optional excerpts cannot bypass it.
Visited expansion keys prevent cycle repetition.
The return edge to the seed survives as an occurrence relation; neither cycle proves execution order.

assertions.cancel: deterministically requested when examined_relationships reaches 3; check before every relationship/serialization step
assertions: No unlimited hidden-count or serialization pass after cancellation.

assertions.clock: fake clock expires after 3 inspected relationships
assertions.note: Finite control-flow assertion, not a measured real-time latency result.

assertions: Direct-call topology is unchanged but source identity/generation changes.
Old cursor supplied against new generation is rejected before work.
Retained old snapshot pages are internally coherent if the API explicitly offers them; never mix old/new ranges/provenance.
Physical handles from the old generation are not silently interpreted against changed offsets.

exclusions: No runtime trace, dynamic receiver, type flow, contract semantics, cross-language relationship, storage-backed cancellation or production query API.
The fixture proves bounded work against >100 ordinary occurrences only; no million-node or large-corpus scale inference.
Exact counts above belong to the grader and must not be supplied to the adapter. Query responses may honestly report lower bounds/unknown when they cannot establish a total within budget.
